title: OldReferenceCallId/NewReferenceCallId added to NonPiiKey type but never added to the all_non_pii const — the new schema-test arms are dead code and the documented 'schema tests fail' guard silently passes
evidence:
audit_log_schema.gleam:87-88: '  OldReferenceCallId
  NewReferenceCallId' (NonPiiKey type, added by this PR); :146-147: 'OldReferenceCallId -> "old_reference_call_id"
NewReferenceCallId -> "new_reference_call_id"'; :187-221: 'pub const all_non_pii: List(NonPiiKey) = [ VacancyId, ... PreviousStatus, RefSlot, ]' — the const ends at RefSlot; the two new variants are NOT members. audit_log_schema_test.gleam:92-93 (this diff): 'schema.OldReferenceCallId -> list.contains(schema.all_non_pii, k)
schema.NewReferenceCallId -> list.contains(schema.all_non_pii, k)' — but the only iteration, :97 'list.each(schema.all_non_pii, fn(k) { non_pii_membership(k) |> should.be_true })', walks the const, which lacks both keys, so these arms never execute. Module doc :10-12 and test header :10-12 both claim 'Add the variant to all_pii / all_non_pii. The schema tests fail until you do' — false: the tests pass vacuously.
detail: The PR added the two substitution-audit detail keys (old_reference_call_id / new_reference_call_id, written by actions_handler.do_substitute) to the typed NonPiiKey registry and its to_string matcher, and added membership-asserting case arms to schema_variants_cover_registry_test — but skipped documented step 3 (adding them to all_non_pii). The membership arms can never run (Gleam cannot enumerate type variants; the test only iterates the const), so the registry-completeness guard the suite was built to provide is silent for exactly these keys. Today the only consumers of all_non_pii_keys() are tests (disjointness check), so there is no immediate runtime break and the keys are non-PII UUIDs — hence warning, not blocker. But the registry is the canonical non-PII key list ('Every non-PII variant. Must cover every constructor of NonPiiKey', :185-186): any future consumer (e.g. DSAR/retention key classification) would silently omit the two new substitution keys, and the test change in this very diff gives false assurance that the registry covers them.
recommended_fix: Add OldReferenceCallId and NewReferenceCallId to the all_non_pii const in server/src/retention/audit_log_schema.gleam (after RefSlot). Optionally tighten schema_variants_cover_registry_test so a forgotten const entry actually fails (e.g. a unit test asserting list.length(all_non_pii) equals the number of NonPiiKey constructors, kept in lockstep with the type).
